theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} [LinearOrder α] [DenselyOrdered α] {s t : Finset α} (hs : s.Nonempty) (ht : t.Nonempty) (H : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ t, x < y) : ∃ b, (∀ x ∈ s, x < b) ∧ ∀ y ∈ t, b < y := by
  let max_s := s.sup
  let min_t := t.inf
  have h_max_s : ∀ x ∈ s, x < max_s := s.sup_le
  have h_min_t : ∀ y ∈ t, min_t < y := le_tinf
  have h_between : ∃ b, max_s < b ∧ b < min_t :=
    DenseOrder.exists_between_iff.2 ⟨max_s, min_t⟩
  rcases h_between with ⟨b, h1, h2⟩
  exact ⟨b, h1, h2⟩
